messages:
Priya (sec-pm): Quick sync — I want to lock the retention windows + rollback clauses for enterprise evidence before we ship the onboarding checklist. Are we ok with a 90-day default + optional 7yr paid tier?
Marcus (eng): +1 for defaults, but need to define 'rollback' precisely. Is that a soft-delete grace period or full restore ability?
Alex (product): Good Q. Proposal: 30-day soft-delete (can un-delete via console/API), 365-day cold-restore (requires ops runbook and paid plan). Anything beyond 365 -> export-only (legal export).
Sam (sre): From ops perspective, 365 cold-restore needs an automated snapshot/restore path or it'll cost us SRE cycles. We should require customers to opt into restore SLAs (extra $).
Taylor (sales): Customers keep asking for ability to pause retention for legal holds and then resume billing — they'd pay if we guarantee a restore window. We should surface pricing delta.
Marcus (eng): Implementation detail: we can tag evidence with lifecycle tiers: active -> archived-hot -> archived-cold -> export-only. ACLs/KMS bindings must persist through tiers. That impacts BYOK handshake.
Priya (sec-pm): Important: BYOK/KMS onboarding must include consent to keep wrapped keys for the duration of retention; legal hold supersedes key rotation in some cases.
Marcus (eng): Right. For BYOK we can store a key-wrapping metadata blob: {"key_handle": "...,", "retain_until": "..."} — need to include rotation policy.
Alex (product): Can we share a short YAML snippet for the retention policy to include in the spec? Priya, Marcus — please review:```retention_policy: default_days: 90 grace_period_days: 30 restore_window_days: 365 long_term_export: true billing_profile: standard|extended_by_request```
Priya (sec-pm): Looks good as a starting point. Add field: `kms_escrow_required: true|false` and `legal_hold_mode: manual|auto-once-flagged`.
Marcus (eng): Will do. Also flag: indexing vs storage tradeoff — if we keep search indices for archived items, cost spikes. Suggest we index only last 12 months by default, and provide paid index retention for older windows.
Taylor (sales): That indexing option will be a selling point for customers who need fast e-discovery. Please include as add-on in pricing docs.
Sam (sre): Ops-runbook items: emergency-access flow (audit log + two-person approval), restore SLA matrix, and retention-driven capacity forecasts. I'll draft runbook stub. ops-bot: Created runbook stub ticket #CI-7890.
Priya (sec-pm): One more constraint: SOC2 evidence export format must be immutable and include chain-of-custody headers (who requested export, at what time, signed by KMS). Add that to the spec.
Marcus (eng): Agreed. We'll append a signed metadata envelope at export time. That ties into key retention — can't export if key revoked. Need a customer-facing warning and a soft-block until key is re-instated or escrow is used.
Alex (product): Decision points for next week: 1) Approve retention defaults (90/30/365) 2) Approve BYOK escrow flag + UX wording 3) Pricing buckets for indexing/restore 4) Ops runbook owners. Priya, Sam, Taylor — can you thumbs-up by EOD? :thumbsup:
Priya (sec-pm): +1 on 90/30/365 and add the SOC2 metadata requirement.
Sam (sre): +1 but want to own restore SLA wording and cost numbers. I'll post estimates by tomorrow.
Taylor (sales): +1, will model three customer price tiers and share next AM.
Marcus (eng): I'll PR the retention schema and BYOK metadata patch after specs doc lands.
Alex (product): Great — I'll capture decisions in the roadmap ticket and schedule a short sync with legal for escrow language. ops-bot: Roadmap ticket created: RP-21456.
